exposure_admissibility.rule: Reject a frozen metadata-WCS pair from counterpart inference if the archive filters string contains either 'blind' or 'PV lens', case-insensitive. No other configuration is removed at this stage.
exposure_admissibility.reason: Conservative pre-pixel configuration gate. The parent exhaustive inventory remains unchanged and is not reinterpreted.

staged_exact_wcs.rule: Sort the 403 admissible file names lexicographically and partition into deterministic contiguous shards. Download files and inspect FITS headers/WCS only; do not read image arrays. Exact celestial WCS containment is evaluated with the existing exact_wcs_pixel contract. Freeze the complete exact-pair CSV and SHA before any image array is read.

representative_selection.preferred_pool: standard broad-band archive configurations whose filters string matches clear z, clear J, clear H, clear K or clear Ks, case-insensitive
representative_selection.fallback_pool: all exposure-admissible exact FITS-WCS pairs for that source
representative_selection.temporal_rule: Within the selected pool, sort unique files by date_obs then file_name and freeze earliest, median and latest indices, deduplicated.

pixel_gate.source_present: Use local R1 coordinate classifier; if present, compute PSF morphology against same-frame SNR-matched local controls.
pixel_gate.source_absent: A no-source result is admitted only when local coordinate injection at SNR 8 and 12 with frame-derived R1 PSF FWHM is recovered at both levels. Otherwise the no-source result is blocked by local sensitivity.

firewall: No Palomar temporal-event, UAP, artificial-origin, ETI, or causal labels may enter exposure admission, exact-WCS scoring, representative selection, source extraction, injection-recovery, or morphology controls.
